requirements: R1: Investigate and categorize the root cause of the review concerns stream anomaly and apply a patch.

slices.title: Analyze and patch search pattern review concerns
slices.jtbd: When implementing the pattern categorization for this epic, I want to identify and patch the missing invariant pattern, so that the review concerns rate drops back to the 0.0000 centerline.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a statistically significant pattern of review concerns,
When the root cause is analyzed,
Then a new invariant pattern should be defined or the existing code patched to prevent the concern, and automated tests must verify the patch.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Review concern root cause analysis bottleneck

epics.title: Fix application runtime launch and health check
epics.jtbd: When the application is deployed, I want it to launch successfully and pass its health checks, so that users and reviewers can access the system.
requirements: R1: The application must start up without crashing.
R2: The application must pass its internal health checks after startup.

slices.title: Patch application startup and health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to resolve the launch failure, so that the application passes health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application is built and deployed,
When it starts up,
Then it should not crash and should return a healthy status on its health check endpoint, with all launch tests passing.

requirements: R1: Fix low contrast text colors for secondary metadata and timestamps against dark backgrounds.

slices.title: Fix contrast for secondary metadata and timestamps
slices.jtbd: When implementing the contrast fix for this epic, I want to increase the contrast ratio of metadata text, so that it meets WCAG accessibility guidelines.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a dark background,
When secondary metadata or timestamps are displayed,
Then their text color should have at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio, verified by automated UI accessibility tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% WCAG AA compliance for metadata contrast
